what_to_detect: A venture resolution by a player with no dungeon in the command zone puts a dungeon there and enters its topmost room.
near_miss: A venture resolution by a player who already has a dungeon in the command zone moves the venture marker in that dungeon.
record_fields: gen-3 command dungeons {player, dungeon, room} before the resolution

what_to_detect: A venture resolution from a room other than the dungeon's bottommost moves the venture marker to an adjacent room of the same dungeon.
near_miss: A venture resolution from the bottommost room completes the dungeon instead.
record_fields: gen-3 command dungeons {player, dungeon, room} before the resolution

what_to_detect: A venture resolution from a dungeon's bottommost room completes that dungeon and enters the topmost room of a new one.
near_miss: A venture resolution from a room above the bottommost moves the marker within the same dungeon.
record_fields: gen-3 command dungeons before the resolution

what_to_detect: A venture-into-[quality] resolution (taking the initiative ventures into Undercity) by a player with no dungeon in the command zone enters the topmost room of a dungeon with that quality.
near_miss: The same resolution by a player who already has a dungeon in the command zone ventures in that dungeon as usual.
record_fields: gen-3 command dungeons before the resolution
